name: Woodwork
description: Cabinets and furniture in sheet goods: carcass generator and cut list.

oneOf.title: Standard
oneOf.description: A box with a top, shelves, doors or drawers.

oneOf.title: Sink base
oneOf.description: Two rails instead of a top, so the sink and its pipes fit. No shelves; doors, or drawers under a false front.

units.title: Units
units.description: Unit of the sizes in this dialog. Inches puts inch sizes in the fields you have not changed.

width.title: Width
width.description: Outside width of the cabinet, side to side.

height.title: Height
height.description: Outside height, from the floor to the top, plinth included.

depth.title: Depth
depth.description: Outside depth, front to back, back board included.

thickness.title: Panel thickness
thickness.description: Thickness of the boards the cabinet is made of: sides, top, bottom, shelves. 18 mm is usual.

back.title: Back
back.description: The thin board that closes the cabinet at the back.

oneOf.title: In a groove
oneOf.description: Slid into a slot cut in the sides, top and bottom, 12 mm from the rear.

oneOf.title: Overlaid
oneOf.description: Nailed or screwed onto the rear edges.

oneOf.title: None
oneOf.description: No back: open behind.

back_thickness.title: Back thickness
back_thickness.description: Thickness of the back board, usually thinner than the rest, such as 6 mm.

wall_mount.title: Wall mount
wall_mount.description: How the cabinet hangs on the wall. A board across the back under the top moves the back forward by its thickness.

oneOf.title: None
oneOf.description: Nothing to hang it by: a floor cabinet, or you fix it yourself.

oneOf.title: French cleat
oneOf.description: A board bevelled at 45 degrees on the cabinet hooks over a matching one screwed to the wall. Needs a back in a groove or none.

oneOf.title: Hanging rail
oneOf.description: A plain board across the back, as thick as the panels and 90 mm high, to screw through into the wall. Needs a back in a groove or none.

oneOf.title: Steel rail
oneOf.description: A steel rail on the wall and two hangers in the cabinet, bought: listed in the cut list's hardware, not drawn.

cleat_height.title: Cleat height
cleat_height.description: Height of each cleat on its long face. The wall cleat hangs below the cabinet's one.

cleat_thickness.title: Cleat thickness
cleat_thickness.description: Thickness of the cleats; the back moves forward by this much.

dividers.title: Dividers
dividers.description: Upright boards inside that split the cabinet into equal compartments side by side.

shelves.title: Shelves
shelves.description: Shelves in each compartment, evenly spaced. With drawers too, behind the doors.

drawers.title: Drawers
drawers.description: Number of drawers. Alone they fill the front, with no shelves; with doors they sit above or below them. Not with dividers. On a sink base, without doors: 2 or more, the top front fixed in front of the sink and the drawers half depth.

drawer_height.title: Drawer front height
drawer_height.description: With doors: the height of each drawer front, 0 for 150 mm. Drawers only: the top drawer's front, and the others share the rest equally; 0 makes them all alike.

drawers_at.title: Drawers at
drawers_at.description: Where the drawers go when the cabinet has doors too.

oneOf.title: Top
oneOf.description: Drawers at the top, the doors and shelves below them.

oneOf.title: Bottom
oneOf.description: Drawers at the bottom, the doors and shelves above them.

plinth.title: Plinth height
plinth.description: The space at floor level under the doors, set back for your toes. 0 for none.

oneOf.title: Board
oneOf.description: A board under each cabinet, set back by Plinth set-back.

oneOf.title: Notched sides
oneOf.description: The sides are cut out at the front bottom, Plinth set-back deep, and there is no board, so you can fit one long board along the whole run.

oneOf.title: Legs
oneOf.description: Adjustable legs under the cabinet, counted in the cut list's hardware. Clip a board onto them later.

oneOf.title: Casters
oneOf.description: Locking casters so the cabinet rolls, for a plinth of 50 mm or more. Counted in the cut list's hardware.

plinth_setback.title: Plinth set-back
plinth_setback.description: How far the plinth board, or the notch in the sides, is back from the front: room for your toes.

shelf_pins.title: Shelf pin holes
shelf_pins.description: Rows of small 5 mm holes inside the sides, 32 mm apart, for pins the shelves rest on. You can move the shelves later.

doors.title: Doors
doors.description: Number of doors: 0, 1, 2, or one per compartment. Each gets holes for 35 mm cup hinges.

door_hinge.title: First door hinged
door_hinge.description: The side the first door hangs on. The next doors alternate; two always open from the middle.

fronts.title: Fronts
fronts.description: How the doors and drawer fronts sit on the cabinet.

oneOf.title: Overlay
oneOf.description: In front of the cabinet, covering the board edges. The usual kitchen look.

oneOf.title: Inset
oneOf.description: Inside the opening, flush with the cabinet's front edges.

reveal.title: Reveal (mm)
reveal.description: The small gap around and between the doors and drawer fronts, so they open without rubbing. 0.5 to 6 mm.

handles.title: Handle holes
handles.description: Holes to screw handles on: in the doors, on the side that opens, and in the drawer fronts.

oneOf.title: Knob
oneOf.description: One hole.

oneOf.title: Pull
oneOf.description: Two holes 128 mm apart, for a bar handle.

handle_position.title: Handle position
handle_position.description: Where on a door the handle holes go. On a drawer front Auto is the middle.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: Top on a floor unit, bottom on a wall unit, middle on a door over 1200 mm.

oneOf.title: Top
oneOf.description: 100 mm from the top.

oneOf.title: Bottom
oneOf.description: 100 mm from the bottom.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Writes each board's name on it, the name the cut list uses, so you can tell the parts apart.

selection.title: Selected cabinet
selection.description: Pick a board of the cabinet to place this one against or to match. Empty: none.

match.title: Match selected
match.description: Take the height, depth, panel thickness and plinth from the selected cabinet, and keep them linked.

oneOf.title: Selected cabinet
oneOf.description: Resize that cabinet later and this one follows.

material.title: Material
material.description: What every board is made of. Change single parts later with Material.

oneOf.title: None
oneOf.description: No material set.

place.title: Place
place.description: Where the new cabinet goes. All but the origin put it against the selected cabinet.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: Against the selected side or top; else at the origin.

oneOf.title: At the origin
oneOf.description: At the centre of the design.

oneOf.title: Right of selected
oneOf.description: Against its right side, backs flush; turned to continue a corner cabinet's return.

oneOf.title: Left of selected
oneOf.description: Against its left side, backs flush.

oneOf.title: Above selected
oneOf.description: On top of it, backs flush.

name.title: Name
name.description: The cabinet's name; each board is named after it, such as Cabinet Side L. A taken name gets the next free number.

units.title: Units
units.description: Unit of the sizes in this dialog. Inches puts inch sizes in the fields you have not changed.

corner.title: Corner
corner.description: Which corner of the room the cabinet fits in.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: Right when placed right of the selected cabinet, else left.

oneOf.title: Left
oneOf.description: Corner at the back left; the return runs forward along the left wall.

oneOf.title: Right
oneOf.description: The mirror image.
Two fronts at a right angle, with a pair of doors that fold together.

oneOf.title: Diagonal
oneOf.description: One front across the corner at 45 degrees, with one door.

boards.title: Bottom, top, shelves
boards.description: How the L-shaped boards are cut from the sheet.

oneOf.title: One piece
oneOf.description: Each an L cut from one board: a big corner may not fit on a sheet.

oneOf.title: Split in two
oneOf.description: Each two rectangles joined with dowels, so a big corner fits on 2440 x 1220 mm sheets.

width.title: Width
width.description: Length along the back wall, from the corner.

return.title: Return
return.description: Length along the side wall, from the corner: the arm that turns the corner.

depth.title: Depth
depth.description: How deep both arms are, wall to front. Diagonal: at the end of the width; at the return's end it is width - return + depth.

height.title: Height
height.description: Outside height, from the floor to the top, plinth included.

thickness.title: Panel thickness
thickness.description: Thickness of the boards the cabinet is made of. 18 mm is usual.

wall_mount.title: Wall mount
wall_mount.description: How the cabinet hangs on the wall. A board along both backs under the top moves the backs forward by its thickness.

oneOf.title: None
oneOf.description: Nothing to hang it by: a floor cabinet, or you fix it yourself.

oneOf.title: Hanging rail
oneOf.description: A plain board along each back, as thick as the panels and 90 mm high, to screw through into the wall.

oneOf.title: Steel rail
oneOf.description: A steel rail on each wall and two hangers each, bought: listed in the cut list's hardware, not drawn.

cleat_height.title: Cleat height
cleat_height.description: Height of each cleat on its long face. The wall cleat hangs below the cabinet's one.

cleat_thickness.title: Cleat thickness
cleat_thickness.description: Thickness of the cleats; the back moves forward by this much.

plinth.title: Plinth height
plinth.description: The space at floor level under the doors, set back for your toes. 0 for none.

oneOf.title: Legs

oneOf.title: Casters

plinth_setback.title: Plinth set-back
plinth_setback.description: How far the plinth board, or the notch in the sides, is back from the front: room for your toes.

shelf_pins.title: Shelf pin holes
shelf_pins.description: Rows of small 5 mm holes in the ends and backs, 32 mm apart, for pins the shelves rest on.

doors.title: Doors
doors.description: Doors with holes for 35 mm cup hinges. L-shaped: a pair that folds together. Diagonal: one door.

oneOf.title: Hinged left
oneOf.description: Hinged at the cabinet's left end, as you face the corner.

oneOf.title: Hinged right
oneOf.description: Hinged at its right end.

fronts.title: Fronts
fronts.description: How the doors sit on the cabinet.

oneOf.title: Overlay
oneOf.description: In front of the cabinet, covering the board edges.

oneOf.title: Inset
oneOf.description: Inside the opening, flush with the cabinet's front edges.

reveal.title: Reveal (mm)
reveal.description: The small gap around the doors, so they open without rubbing. 0.5 to 6 mm.

handles.title: Handle holes
handles.description: Holes to screw a handle on. L-shaped: in the door that folds, at its free end. Diagonal: at the opening edge.

oneOf.title: Knob
oneOf.description: One hole.

oneOf.title: Pull

handle_position.title: Handle position
handle_position.description: Where on a door the handle holes go.

name.title: Name
name.description: The cabinet's name; each board is named after it, such as Corner Side L. A taken name gets the next free number.

selection.title: Selected cabinet
selection.description: Pick any board of the cabinet to change. Keep leaves a choice as it is.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Box cabinet only: a standard cabinet or a sink base, with rails instead of a top.

shelves.title: Shelves
shelves.description: Shelves in each compartment. Empty: as it is.

dividers.title: Dividers
dividers.description: Upright boards that split the inside into compartments. Empty: as it is. Box cabinet only.

doors.title: Doors
doors.description: Number of doors. Empty: as it is. Box cabinet only.

drawers.title: Drawers
drawers.description: Number of drawers. Empty: as it is. Box cabinet only. On a sink base, without doors: 2 or more, the top front a false front.

drawer_height.title: Drawer front height
drawer_height.description: With doors: each drawer front, 0 for 150 mm. Drawers only: the top front, the rest share what is left; 0 for all alike. In the cabinet's unit. Empty: as it is. Box cabinet only.

drawers_at.title: Drawers at
drawers_at.description: With doors too: the drawers at the top or the bottom. Box cabinet only.

reveal.title: Reveal (mm)
reveal.description: The small gap around the doors and drawer fronts. Empty: as it is.

door_hinge.title: First door hinged
door_hinge.description: The side the first door hangs on. Box cabinet only.

fronts.title: Fronts
fronts.description: Overlay: in front of the cabinet. Inset: inside the opening.

corner_doors.title: Corner doors
corner_doors.description: Which end the doors hang on. Corner cabinet only.

shape.title: Corner shape
shape.description: The shape of the front. Corner cabinet only.

back.title: Back
back.description: The thin board at the back. Box cabinet only.

wall_mount.title: Wall mount
wall_mount.description: How the cabinet hangs on the wall.

oneOf.title: French cleat
oneOf.description: A box cabinet needs a back in a groove or none.

oneOf.title: Hanging rail
oneOf.description: A box cabinet needs a back in a groove or none.

oneOf.title: Steel rail
oneOf.description: Bought: in the cut list's hardware.

shelf_pins.title: Shelf pin holes
shelf_pins.description: Rows of small 5 mm holes for pins the shelves rest on.

handles.title: Handle holes
handles.description: Holes to screw handles on, in doors and drawer fronts.

handle_position.title: Handle position
handle_position.description: Where on a door the handle goes.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Each board's name written on it.

plinth_type.title: Plinth type
plinth_type.description: A board set back under the cabinet, notched sides for one long board along a run, legs, or casters.

plinth.title: Plinth height
plinth.description: The space at floor level under the doors. In the cabinet's unit; 0 for none. Empty: as it is.

plinth_setback.title: Plinth set-back
plinth_setback.description: How far the plinth board or the sides' notch is back from the front. In the cabinet's unit. Empty: as it is.

selection.title: Selected cabinet
selection.description: Pick any board of the cabinet to drill.

type.title: Type
type.description: How the sides are fixed to the bottom and top: holes are drilled where they meet.

oneOf.title: Confirmat screws
oneOf.description: Thick 7 x 50 mm furniture screws: a 7 mm hole through the side and a 5 mm pilot hole.

oneOf.title: Dowels
oneOf.description: 8 mm holes for 8 x 35 mm wooden pegs glued into both boards.

selection.title: Selected
selection.description: Pick a board of the cabinet, or the parts to change.

material.title: Material
material.description: What the boards are made of. The cut list groups parts by it.

oneOf.title: Whole cabinet
oneOf.description: Every board of the cabinet you picked a part of.

oneOf.title: Selected parts
oneOf.description: Only the picked parts, such as the doors.

selection.title: Selected cabinet
selection.description: Pick the side of the box cabinet that gets the panel.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: A finishing board on one end of the cabinet. It is part of the cabinet: it follows its sizes and Edit cabinet keeps it.

oneOf.title: End panel
oneOf.description: A board over the side, from the floor to the top and from the back to the faces of the fronts.

oneOf.title: Filler
oneOf.description: A strip beside the fronts that closes a gap to a wall, with a return board behind it back to the wall.

side.title: Side
side.description: Which end of the cabinet, as seen from the front.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: The side you picked: Side L or Side R.

units.title: Units
units.description: Unit of the sizes below. Inches puts inch sizes in the fields you have not changed.

width.title: Filler width
width.description: How far the filler reaches out from the cabinet, its thickness included.

thickness.title: Thickness
thickness.description: 0 takes the cabinet's own board thickness and follows it; or give a thickness of its own.

selection.title: Selected cabinets
selection.description: Pick a board of each cabinet the worktop goes over: one straight run, or runs that meet in corners. Pick a worktop to make it again over its cabinets.

units.title: Units
units.description: Unit of the sizes in this dialog. Inches puts inch sizes in the fields you have not changed.

joint.title: Corner joint
joint.description: How two pieces meet where the run turns a corner.

oneOf.title: Butt
oneOf.description: The longer piece runs through to the wall; the other stops against its front edge.

oneOf.title: Mitre
oneOf.description: Both pieces run to the walls and are cut on the line from the inside corner to the outside one.

thickness.title: Thickness
thickness.description: Thickness of the worktop. 38 mm is usual in a kitchen.

front_overhang.title: Front overhang
front_overhang.description: How far the worktop reaches past the deepest cabinet's front. Doors stand about 20 mm proud. The back is flush with the wall.

left_overhang.title: Left end overhang
left_overhang.description: How far it reaches past the free left end of the run, seen from the front.

right_overhang.title: Right end overhang
right_overhang.description: How far it reaches past the free right end of the run, seen from the front.

dog_holes.title: Dog holes
dog_holes.description: 20 mm holes through the first piece on a 96 mm grid, for bench dogs and clamps.

oneOf.title: All over
oneOf.description: The grid centred on the piece, at least 60 mm from its edges.

oneOf.title: In a zone
oneOf.description: The grid centred in a rectangle you give.

zone_x.title: Zone from left
zone_x.description: From the piece's left end to the zone's left edge.

zone_y.title: Zone from front
zone_y.description: From the piece's front edge to the zone's front edge.

zone_length.title: Zone length
zone_length.description: The zone's size along the piece.

zone_width.title: Zone width
zone_width.description: The zone's size from front to back.

cutout.title: Cut-out
cutout.description: An opening through the first piece, for a sink, a hob or a router plate.

oneOf.title: Plain
oneOf.description: A rectangular hole straight through.

oneOf.title: Rebated
oneOf.description: The hole with a shallow ledge all round at the top, so a plate or a sink rim sits flush.

cutout_length.title: Opening length
cutout_length.description: The hole's size along the piece.

cutout_width.title: Opening width
cutout_width.description: The hole's size from front to back.

cutout_x.title: Opening from left
cutout_x.description: From the piece's left end to the middle of the hole.

cutout_y.title: Opening from front
cutout_y.description: From the piece's front edge to the middle of the hole.

rebate_width.title: Ledge width
rebate_width.description: How far the shallow ledge reaches out from the hole on every side.

rebate_depth.title: Ledge depth
rebate_depth.description: How deep the ledge is from the top: the plate's thickness.

material.title: Material
material.description: What the worktop is made of.

oneOf.title: None
oneOf.description: No material set.

name.title: Name
name.description: Names the pieces: Worktop 1, Worktop 2. A name with Worktop in it is bought to length in the cut list. Run again with the same name, it replaces that worktop.

banding.title: Edge banding
banding.description: A thin strip glued onto visible board edges to cover them. Doors and drawer fronts get it all round, other boards at the front.

size.title: Sizes
size.description: Which size the list gives for a banded part.

oneOf.title: Finished
oneOf.description: As in the model, banding included.

oneOf.title: Cut
oneOf.description: The size to saw: less the banding on each banded edge.

sheet.title: Sheet size
sheet.description: Size of the boards you buy, length x width in mm. The cutting layouts fit the parts onto these.

kerf.title: Saw kerf (mm)
kerf.description: Width of the saw blade: the wood lost to each cut, left between parts on the sheet.

trim.title: Edge trim (mm)
trim.description: Cut off each edge of the sheet first, as factory edges are often chipped or not square.

diagrams.title: Cutting diagrams
diagrams.description: A drawing of each sheet in the PDF, showing where each part is cut from.

format.title: Format
format.description: The kind of file Save as writes.

oneOf.title: PDF
oneOf.description: A cut list to print.

oneOf.title: CSV
oneOf.description: A table for a spreadsheet.

oneOf.title: Labels (PDF)
oneOf.description: A sticker per board, 24 on an A4 sheet.

oneOf.title: DXF
oneOf.description: One drawing per sheet: parts, names and holes, for a CNC.

file.title: Save as
file.description: File name, saved in the folder approved at install. Empty: no file, the list only shows in the result.

selection.title: Selected cabinet
selection.description: Pick any board of the cabinet to draw.

scope.title: Draw
scope.description: A workshop sheet per cabinet in the drawing Woodwork: front, side and 3D views, sizes and its boards.

units.title: Units
units.description: Unit of the panel thickness and plinth height below. Kept in mm, shown in the Cabinet dialog's own unit.

material.title: Material
material.description: The material new cabinets start with in this design. Keep leaves the one stored.

oneOf.title: None
oneOf.description: No material set.

thickness.title: Panel thickness
thickness.description: The board thickness new cabinets start with: the stored one, else 18 mm.

reveal.title: Reveal (mm)
reveal.description: The gap around doors and drawer fronts new cabinets start with, 0.5 to 6 mm: the stored one, else 2 mm.

handles.title: Handle holes
handles.description: The handle holes new cabinets start with. Keep leaves the one stored.

plinth.title: Plinth height
plinth.description: The plinth height new cabinets start with, 0 for none: the stored one, else 0.

plinth_type.title: Plinth type
plinth_type.description: What fills the plinth height on new cabinets. Keep leaves the one stored.
